article.summary_es: St. Mark AME Church/The Voice of Hagar es una despensa de alimentos en Jackson Heights, Queens, que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Abre los martes de 10am a 12:30pm.
article.summary_en: St. Mark AME Church/The Voice of Hagar is a food pantry in Jackson Heights, Queens, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is open on Tuesdays from 10am to 12:30pm.
how_they_help_es: Aparece como despensa de alimentos en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está en 95-18 Northern Blvd, en Jackson Heights, Queens.
Abre los martes de 10am a 12:30pm (despensa el 1.er, 2.º, 3.er y 4.º martes).
Puede llamar al (718) 205-0506 para preguntar qué alimentos entrega y qué requisitos hay.
how_they_help_en: Listed as a food pantry on the City's Food Help NYC map.
Located at 95-18 Northern Blvd in Jackson Heights, Queens.
Open Tuesdays from 10am to 12:30pm (pantry on the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th Tuesdays).
You can call (718) 205-0506 to ask about the food given and any requirements.
visit_tips_es: Visite un martes entre 10am y 12:30pm; la despensa funciona el 1.er, 2.º, 3.er y 4.º martes.
Llame antes al (718) 205-0506 para confirmar que la despensa estará abierta ese día.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos, así que pregunte por teléfono.
visit_tips_en: Visit on a Tuesday between 10am and 12:30pm; the pantry runs on the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th Tuesdays.
Call (718) 205-0506 ahead to confirm the pantry is open that day.
What food is given and any requirements are not listed, so ask by phone.
